description: This PHP source file defines the 'SecurityGroupMessage' class, which represents messages associated with security groups within SugarCRM. It includes properties for database schema, methods for retrieving list view data, saving messages, and calculating time lapses, as well as external references to other modules such as SecurityGroups and Users.

classes.name: SecurityGroupMessage
classes.description: Represents messages tied to security groups, with properties for schema mapping and methods for list view rendering, message saving, and time calculations.

methods.name: get_list_view_data
methods.description: Prepares and returns data for list view display, including security group and user information, and delete action icon.

methods.name: saveMessage
methods.description: Static method to save a new message associated with a security group, ensuring proper permissions.

methods.name: getTimeLapse
methods.description: Calculates and returns a human-readable elapsed time since the provided start date.

methods.name: bean_implements
methods.description: Indicates the interfaces this bean implements, returning false for 'ACL'.
